dropped.title: Why 0xDEADC0D3 had to die
dropped.note: nullDC4Wii: unmapped reads returned 0xDEADC0D3; a game added an offset and wrote to 0xDEADE5F3

dropped.title: pack(4), not pack(1): Broadway's load-hit-store
dropped.note: Wii PowerPC: pack(1) made every TA float bounce through the stack, a load-hit-store stall per read

dropped.title: IDLE_KAMUI: skipping the Kamui2 vsync wait
dropped.note: Detects the Kamui2 vsync wait loop at compile time; on PS3, Ikaruga went from 77.2% to 87.3% speed

dropped.title: RENDER_DELAY: why MvC2 needs slow interrupts
dropped.note: Raising TA/render IRQs instantly breaks MvC2's frame pacing, so the delays copy real hardware timing

dropped.title: Dreamcast RAM written over IOS's buffers
dropped.note: MEM2 bump allocs ran past Arena2Hi; whether a USB drive was mounted decided if a game died

dropped.title: IDLE_SHINOBI: paying off the idle task's debt
dropped.note: A JIT rule spots the Shinobi library's idle task walk; PS3 tests took Garou fights to 60 fps

added.title: Why the VMU saves came out empty
added.note: Wii U port: devices are set up twice, so a file held open made the second open fail and saves were 0 bytes

added.title: 64-bit reads: which word goes first
added.note: Swapped words in 64-bit fmov copies turned the BIOS soft-reset code into garbage (MvC2 after game over)

added.title: Slower and lower instead of stuttering
added.note: Wii U sound bends its resampling to the emulator's real speed; stop-and-restart at ~76% was unbearable

added.title: HarissaDC writes its own flash
added.note: No Sega BIOS: the HLE BIOS formats the flash, writes '00000Dreamcast' and counts the clock from 1950

added.title: Booting with no BIOS
added.note: HarissaDC's HLE BIOS points the system call vectors at traps and sets the SH4 registers by hand

added.title: Sprite atlases and the 0xDEADBEEF sentinel
added.note: Texture caches checked one sentinel word; SF3 and Guilty Gear redraw atlas tiles, so stale tiles stayed
